patterns.note: Asymmetric split sections with full-bleed content, often featuring a large image or video on one side and text on the other.
Monospaced text is used consistently for labels, body copy, and secondary information, creating a technical, precise feel that contrasts with large, bold sans-serif headings.
A high-contrast palette of stark black and white is consistently used for backgrounds and text, with a vibrant neon green serving as the sole accent color for CTAs and highlights.
The main header navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Fixed 'Try Now' call-to-action buttons are positioned on the left and right sides of the initial hero section, disappearing once the user scrolls past the hero content.
Dynamic, generative animations are used for background elements, specifically a video/canvas in the hero and a glitch-like effect in the footer, adding a high-tech visual texture.
Full-width sections alternate between light (white) and dark (black) backgrounds, creating clear visual separation and rhythm down the page.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero section features a dynamic canvas or video background with text overlaid directly, creating an immersive initial experience.
A persistent header navigation remains fixed at the top of the viewport during scroll, ensuring constant access to key links.
Content sections are designed to reveal or fade into view as they enter the viewport, using scroll-triggered animations to guide the user's attention.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~4-5x body) paired with smaller, monospaced body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners universally applied to all elements, including buttons, images, and section boundaries.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between full-width sections and a more dense grid for feature cards.

standout: The site's distinctive use of stark black and white, punctuated by neon green, combined with a blend of oversized, bold sans-serif typography and precise monospaced text, creates a high-tech, almost brutalist aesthetic. The dynamic, generative animations in the hero and footer, along with the unique disappearing side CTAs, elevate it beyond a standard marketing site.
